arguments.explanation: Deliverable routing sheet: ticket id, suggested queue, confidence, and a low-confidence review flag.
arguments.name: new_tickets_routing_result
arguments.sql:
SELECT
  ticket_id,
  prediction AS suggested_queue,
  ROUND(prediction_score, 3) AS confidence,
  CASE WHEN prediction_score < 0.50 THEN '需人工复核' ELSE '可直接分流' END AS routing_action,
  customer_batch,
  channel,
  message
FROM input
ORDER BY prediction_score ASC

arguments.query: 工单分流队列规则 物流 退换货 发票 队列判断

arguments.sql: SELECT * FROM input

SELECT queue, channel, COUNT(*) AS n,
       COUNT(DISTINCT customer_batch) AS batches,
       COUNT(DISTINCT message) AS distinct_msgs,
       ROUND(AVG(LENGTH(message)),1) AS avg_len
FROM input GROUP BY queue, channel ORDER BY queue, channel

SELECT customer_batch,
       COUNT(*) AS n,
       COUNT(DISTINCT queue) AS n_queues,
       string_agg(queue, ',' ORDER BY queue) AS queues
FROM input GROUP BY customer_batch ORDER BY customer_batch

SELECT queue,
       SUM(CASE WHEN message LIKE '%签收%' OR message LIKE '%快递%' OR message LIKE '%物流%' OR message LIKE '%包裹%' OR message LIKE '%派送%' OR message LIKE '%deliver%' OR message LIKE '%parcel%' OR message LIKE '%shipping%' OR message LIKE '%courier%' OR message LIKE '%tracking%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mentions_logistics_words,
       COUNT(*) AS n
FROM input GROUP BY queue ORDER BY queue

SELECT prediction, COUNT(*) AS n,
       ROUND(AVG(prediction_score),3) AS avg_score,
       SUM(CASE WHEN prediction_score < 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS below_060,
       SUM(CASE WHEN prediction_score < 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS below_050
FROM input GROUP BY prediction ORDER BY n DESC

       SUM(CASE WHEN prediction = queue THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matched,
       ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN prediction = queue THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),1) AS pct
FROM input
